test_GridSearchCV_basic_search: test GridSearchCV to exhaustively search over a given parameter grid for the best estimator
test_RandomizedSearchCV_stochastic_searc: test RandomizedSearchCV to sample a fixed number of parameter settings from a distribution
test_ParallelGridSearchCV: test GridSearchCV with parallel job execution using n_jobs for faster hyperparameter tuning
test_callable_multimetric_scorer: test GridSearchCV with a callable scorer that returns multiple named metrics in a dictionary
test_custom_refit_callable: test GridSearchCV with a custom callable refit function to select the best estimator by arbitrary criteria
